findings.message: The findings file lifecycle after submit is unspecified (committed, deleted, untracked or ignored); say it is never part of the bound tree.
The section 7 file inventory has no row for .codictator/reviews/<task-id>-r<round>.json, and the version/tree/reviewerSession envelope is defined nowhere.
Its base branch is undefined for the merge-base comparison; name the default branch. Row 6 accepts wontfix while core/bug-registry in 4.9.4 says fixed.
